slides.title: Murshid
slides.subtitle: The AI agent that plans every student's week and gives teachers the full picture
slides.notes: Murshid (Arabic for 'guide'). Entry for the Best Youth AI Agent category of the Dubai Chamber of Digital Economy's Create AI Agents Championship. January 2027 submission = prototype + pitch deck + demo video, English only. Source: https://www.dubaichamberdigital.com/en/create-ai-agents (fetched 15 Oct 2026).

slides.title: Nobody sees a student's whole week.
slides.body: Students juggle every subject, test and fixture alone. Teachers set homework without seeing what else is due.
slides.notes: The problem in one line. A Grade 11 student has work from several subjects, tests, sport fixtures and activities arriving through different teachers, with no single view of the week. Each teacher sets homework without seeing the rest of the class's load, so deadlines pile onto the same days. Outcome we want: every student on top of their work, every teacher with the full picture.

slides.title: The problem

items.heading: Students in Dubai private schools in 2026–27 (KHDA)
Counsellor ratio at Our Own High School

slides.notes: Who is affected: students (missed or piled-up deadlines), teachers (set work blind to other subjects; struggling students spotted late) and counsellors/parents (no weekly picture). Sources: 406,563 students, up 4.6% from ~388,731 in June 2026, KHDA Media Majlis 1 Oct 2026, reported by Gulf Education 5 Oct 2026: https://gulf.education/dubai-private-school-enrolment-406000-khda-priorities/ . OOW key facts (4,659 students, 5 counsellors; page last updated 18 Apr 2026): https://edcare.ae/schools/our-own-high-school/fees . 4,659 / 5 = 932, rounded to 1:930. Survey data on how often students miss deadlines does not exist yet; it is part of the validation plan.

slides.title: An agent that acts
slides.body: Murshid reads the timetable and the work that teachers set, plans each week, and acts only with a person's approval.
slides.notes: Transition from the problem to the agent. Murshid is more than a chatbot: it takes a goal, plans steps, calls tools on real school data and takes actions, with a human approval step for anything that writes or goes outbound.

slides.title: How the agent works
slides.image_prompt: Diagram rendered from HTML (not a screenshot): goal → plan → tools → actions → human approval, with model routing strip.
slides.body: Rules route first. Models plan. A person approves every write.
slides.notes: How Murshid reasons, plans, uses tools and takes action. 1) Goal: e.g. 'plan my week around my mid-term and both sports'. 2) Plan: a lead agent splits the request across specialist sub-agents (academics, sports, opportunities, career/CV, planner, wellbeing). 3) Tools: timetable and tasks, Microsoft 365 / Teams classes and assignments (connector built; sign-in SIMULATED in the prototype), calendar, opportunity search over a crawled UAE database, CV builder (PDF). 4) Actions: build the week plan, create tasks, save an opportunity with a checklist, generate a LinkedIn-ready CV. 5) Guardrails: tools with side effects need the student's confirmation (needs_confirmation in the tool registry); only the lead agent may write; every change is logged in the school's audit log; integrity check stops ghost-writing of assessed work. Model routing: rules handle simple intents at no model cost; prototype uses NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super / Nemotron 3.5 Lightning on OpenRouter free tier, with the rules engine as fallback when a model fails or hits quota. Production plan: cheap model as router and for chat, a stronger model for heavy planning, per-student budget ledger with economy tier. Source: /workspace/murshid packages/agent-gateway (orchestrator.ts, sub-agents.ts, tools.ts, provider.ts) and docs/simulations/README.md.

slides.title: Safe by design

items.heading: UAE law first
items.body: Consent-based processing under the PDPL. Under-13s blocked by a neutral age gate. Guardians for 13–17. No ads.

items.heading: Separate tenants
items.body: School data never mixes with family accounts. Teachers see only the classes they teach.

items.heading: Human in charge
items.body: Any action that writes needs the student's approval. Every change goes to the school's audit log.

slides.notes: UAE PDPL (Federal Decree-Law 45/2021): consent is the default lawful basis and must be easy to withdraw; Executive Regulations still pending. Child Digital Safety law (Federal Decree-Law 26/2025): in force 1 Jan 2026 with one year to comply; no collecting or processing data of under-13s without explicit, documented parental consent, no commercial use or targeted ads, high-privacy defaults, parental controls. Source: Latham & Watkins, 9 Jan 2026, https://www.lw.com/en/insights/uaes-child-digital-safety-law-what-every-digital-platform-and-isp-should-know . Prototype today: packages/privacy has a neutral age gate (MIN_AGE 13, guardian needed under 18), consent records, data-rights export/delete, AI-use log and audit log; tool registry refuses side-effect tools without confirmation. If a school licenses Murshid for under-13 grades, verified parental consent is required before any processing. Planned before the pilot: DPIA, zero-data-retention model settings, UAE-region hosting for student records. Not legal advice.

slides.title: Business model

items.heading: USD AI cost per student-month · estimate

slides.notes: Annual family options: Plus AED 249 a year, Pro AED 699 a year. Schools first: a school licenses Murshid per student per year; families can buy Plus or Pro directly. Example (illustrative, not a customer): a 1,300-student secondary school at AED 120–150 = about AED 156k–195k a year. AI cost ~USD 0.49 per active student per month is an INTERNAL ESTIMATE (docs/submission/cost_estimate.py): assumed monthly usage per active student, cheap model mix with NO DeepSeek (ruled out for personal data): OpenAI GPT-6 Luna for routing, everyday chat and research (USD 0.10 in / 0.50 out per 1M tokens; weekly briefing on the batch rate 0.05 / 0.25), Google Gemini 3.8 Flash for week planning and CV help (0.75 / 3.75), Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite for long notes and photo OCR (0.25 / 1.50). Prices from the OpenRouter models API (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models), checked 15 Oct 2026. Not measured in production. A premium mix with heavy planning on a top model was estimated at ~USD 1.29. At AED 150/year (~USD 3.40 a month) the cheap-mix AI cost is ~14% of licence revenue. Pricing source: product pricing page (docs/SCHOOLS.md, feature-list.md).
